lines.text: and do not let me sink;
and out of the deep waters.
Do not let the floods engulf me
or the depths swallow me up;
let not the Pit close its mouth over me.
for Your loving devotion is good;
turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.
Hide not Your face from Your servant,
Draw near to my soul and redeem me;
ransom me because of my foes.

pictures.scene: Constantin Meunier, Mijnwerkers bij de schacht - miners hauled up out of the pit at the end of the shift, answer me with Your sure salvation and rescue me from the mire
pictures.name: pd_meunier_mijnwerkers_bij_de_schacht

pictures.scene: Theodore Gudin, Zeeslag bij Alicudi - a ship going down in smoke and heavy sea with men in the water, do not let me sink, deliver me from my foes
pictures.name: pd_gudin_zeeslag_bij_alicudi

pictures.scene: Wassily Kandinsky, Stormachtige zee bij Rapallo - the sea heaped up grey and white against the shore, do not let the floods engulf me
pictures.name: pd_kandinsky_stormachtige_zee_bij_rapallo

pictures.scene: Carl Friedrich Lessing, Rotslandschap met ruine - a black cleft in the rock dropping away below a ruined tower, let not the Pit close its mouth over me
pictures.name: pd_lessing_rotslandschap_met_ruine

pictures.scene: Jacek Malczewski, Aankondiging - the angel come close to a man at work in the open field, Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good
pictures.name: pd_malczewski_aankondiging

pictures.scene: Adam Camerarius, Christus en de hoofdman - the centurion kneeling in the road and Christ turning to him, turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion, hide not Your face from Your servant
pictures.name: pd_camerarius_christus_en_de_hoofdman

pictures.scene: Adolph Tidemand, Het zieke kind - the family crowded round the bed of the sick child, for I am in distress, answer me quickly
pictures.name: pd_tidemand_het_zieke_kind

pictures.scene: Peter Paul Rubens, De ontmoeting van David en Abigail - Abigail kneeling in the road to turn the armed king aside and save her house, draw near to my soul and redeem me, ransom me because of my foes
pictures.name: pd_rubens_ontmoeting_van_david_en_abigail
